## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm lint`
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] Updated tests and docs where behavior changed

## DSH and security checklist

- [ ] Tool schema and canonical output remain compatible with DSH
- [ ] Local-path, URL, or output-limit changes include security coverage
- [ ] No credentials, documents, generated artifacts, or large models are committed
